title: Expected hyperbolic volumes of random beta polytopes
summary: Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ be independent random points in the closed unit ball of $\mathbb{R}^d$. Assume that each $X_i$ has a beta distribution with parameter $β_i \ge -1$: if $β_i>-1$, then $X_i$ has Lebesgue density proportional to $(1-\|x\|^2)^{β_i}$ on $\{\|x\|<1\}$, whereas the case $β_i=-1$ corresponds to the uniform distribution on the unit sphere $\{\|x\|=1\}$. Let $[X_1,\ldots,X_n]$ denote the convex hull of these points.
